seoTitle: Which From Character Are You? From TV Series Test (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the From test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Boyd, Jim, Tabitha, Donna, Jade, Kenny, Sara or Victor — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the one holding everyone together when things go wrong, the practical fixer who wants proof, or the one who's seen far more than they let on? Answer 12 questions about how you really handle trouble, strangers and the unexplained, and find out which From character you are.

characters.name: Boyd Stevens
characters.title: The Burdened Leader
characters.summary: Strong, principled and carrying the weight of everyone around you. People look to you when things fall apart — and they always do.
description: Like Boyd, you're the one in charge. He's the sheriff and de facto leader of the town, keeping people alive night after night.
You carry a lot, and you carry it alone. Boyd hides his own struggles so everyone else can keep going.
You'll do whatever it takes to protect people — including going places nobody else would dare.
characters.flaw: You take on too much and refuse to let anyone help carry it.
characters.signature: A sheriff's badge, a steady voice and the rules for surviving the night.
characters.clashReason: they'd make every decision for everyone

characters.name: Jim Matthews
characters.title: The Practical Problem-Solver
characters.summary: Logical, hands-on and determined to fix things. If there's a way out, you'll build it.
description: Like Jim, you believe every problem has a practical solution. He's an engineer, and he helped build a radio tower to try to reach the outside world.
You're sceptical of the supernatural stuff. You want answers you can measure.
Above all, you're a devoted dad who'll do anything to get his family home.
characters.flaw: You dismiss what you can't explain, even when it's right in front of you.
characters.signature: A toolbox, a half-built radio and a very stubborn plan.
characters.clashReason: they'd want a logical answer for everything

characters.name: Tabitha Matthews
characters.title: The Relentless Seeker
characters.summary: Determined, intuitive and unwilling to accept 'we'll never know'. You dig — literally — until you find the truth.
description: Like Tabitha, you need answers. While others try to survive, she's chasing the town's secrets.
You follow your gut, even when it leads somewhere terrifying. Tabitha has gone further into the mystery than almost anyone.
You're fiercely protective of your kids, and the need to get them out drives everything you do.
characters.flaw: You chase the truth so hard that you sometimes leave the people you love behind.
characters.signature: A flashlight, a shovel and a hunch she can't let go of.
characters.clashReason: they'd chase every mystery, whatever the risk

characters.name: Donna Raines
characters.title: The Tough Protector
characters.summary: Blunt, tough and fiercely protective of your people. You don't sugarcoat anything — and everyone's better off for it.
description: Like Donna, you run a tight ship. She leads Colony House, where the residents share chores, keep order and look after each other.
You're blunt. You say what needs saying, and you don't care if it's comfortable.
Under the tough exterior, you care deeply about the people who rely on you.
characters.flaw: You keep people at arm's length and trust almost no one.
characters.signature: A firm hand, a sharp tongue and a house full of people depending on her.
characters.clashReason: they'd boss you around and never explain why

characters.name: Jade Herrera
characters.title: The Arrogant Genius
characters.summary: Brilliant, cocky and haunted by things you can't explain. You'd rather crack the puzzle than play nice.
description: Like Jade, you're smart and you know it. He was a wealthy software developer before the town swallowed him up.
You're sarcastic and a little arrogant, and people don't always like you at first.
But you see patterns nobody else does. Jade became obsessed with the symbols he keeps seeing — and with what they might mean.
characters.flaw: Your ego gets in the way, and you push people away.
characters.signature: A notebook full of strange symbols and a sarcastic comment.
characters.clashReason: they'd be sarcastic about everything you care about

characters.name: Kenny Liu
characters.title: The Kind-Hearted Deputy
characters.summary: Loyal, gentle and braver than you look. You're the good heart of a town that badly needs one.
description: Like Kenny, you're dependable. He's Boyd's deputy and right-hand man, and he shows up every time he's needed.
You're gentle and kind in a place that makes that very hard. Kenny lost his father in the first season and his mother later on — and he still shows up for everyone else.
You don't want to be a hero — but when it counts, you step up.
characters.flaw: You doubt yourself and follow orders even when your gut disagrees.
characters.signature: A deputy's uniform and a kind word for everyone.
characters.clashReason: they'd be too nice to make the hard call

characters.name: Sara Myers
characters.title: The Haunted Outsider
characters.summary: Complicated, misunderstood and hearing things nobody else can. You've done things you're not proud of — and you're still trying to make it right.
description: Like Sara, you're not easy to understand. She hears voices, and they've led her to terrible places.
You're an outsider. People don't trust you, and you're not sure they should.
But you're a survivor, and you're trying — harder than anyone knows — to become someone better.
characters.flaw: You listen to the wrong voices.
characters.signature: A haunted stare, a voice in her head and a secret she can't escape.
characters.clashReason: they'd keep secrets you'd never guess

characters.name: Victor
characters.title: The One Who Remembers
characters.summary: Gentle, strange and full of secrets. You've seen more than anyone — and you're only just starting to understand it.
description: Like Victor, you've been around longer than anyone. He arrived in the town as a young boy, decades ago, and he's the only one who survived from that time.
You notice everything. Victor draws what he sees, and his drawings hold clues nobody else can read.
You're gentle and childlike in some ways, but you carry memories that terrify you.
characters.flaw: You hide from painful memories — even when they could help.
characters.signature: A box of crayons, a stack of drawings and a very long memory.
characters.clashReason: they'd know things they'd never tell you

questions.text: You're moving into a shared house full of strangers. You...

options.text: Draw up a chore rota on day one
Make everyone feel welcome
Keep to yourself. They don't need to know you
Take the best room and make a joke about it
Fix something around the house. There's always something
Fall down an internet rabbit hole about an old mystery
Batch-cook for the week and get everyone else helping
Sleep in, then complain there's nothing to do

questions.text: Your friend group starts falling apart in a crisis. You...

options.text: Step up and take charge
Keep the peace and check on everyone
Tell everyone some hard truths
Watch quietly. You notice who's really struggling
Keep it to yourself so nobody worries
Talk it through logically, step by step
Can't stop thinking about it until it's solved
Draw it. It's easier than saying it

questions.text: You made a serious mistake that hurt someone. You...

options.text: Spend a long time trying to earn forgiveness
Own it, then work even harder to protect everyone
Apologise, awkwardly, many times
Act like it wasn't a big deal

questions.text: A friend tells you something that sounds impossible. You...

options.text: Ask for evidence
Believe them. Your gut says it's true
Take it in your stride. You've seen stranger things
You know what it's like not to be believed. So you listen

questions.text: You're asked to lead something you don't feel ready for. You...

options.text: Say yes, doubt yourself the whole way — and do fine
Fine. Someone has to, and it may as well be you
Only if you get to do it your way
Make a plan, a checklist and a backup plan

questions.text: You start a new hobby. It's...

options.text: Drawing. You fill notebook after notebook
Long walks alone, no phone
Starting a community garden — and running it
Tracing your family tree. You want to know where you really come from

questions.text: You hear a strange noise in the house at night. You...

options.text: Grab a torch and go and check
Lie completely still and listen. Carefully
Follow the sound. You need to know what it is
Pretend you didn't hear it. Some things you don't answer

questions.text: Everyone at a new place insists you follow some very strange rules. You...

options.text: Follow them. People must have their reasons
Keep asking why until someone explains
Test them. Rules without logic are made to be broken
Learn them properly — and make sure everyone sticks to them

questions.text: You live in a town where monsters come out after dark. A stranger turns up just before sunset — nobody knows them, and they won't say how they got here. There's a spare bed in your house. You...

options.text: Let them in. Nobody should be outside tonight
Give them the bed — then ask everything about how they got here
Take them in — under your rules
Say no. Not worth the risk

questions.text: You're trapped in a town nobody can leave. Food is running low — there's only enough for everyone if people take less, and some families have kids. You...

options.text: Start planting. Nobody goes hungry if you can help it
Quietly give away your share and tell no one
Share what you've been saving. You always keep extra
Take charge of the rationing yourself
